verdict.rationale: Highnote explicitly documents an agentic-commerce solution: 'Issue cards per agent, workflow, or vendor via API. Each card closes automatically when the workflow ends' plus merchant category restrictions, velocity limits, and per-transaction caps evaluated at authorization before funds move, matching the story's scoped-card-for-agents use case by name. missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of an agent actually being issued and using such a card, and more detail on expiry mechanics beyond 'closes when workflow ends.'
